Andrew Wallach decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 95.53% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Cumberland Partners Ltd sold 48,297 shares as the company’s stock rose 5.37% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Andrew Wallach held 2,260 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $379,000, down from 50,557 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Cumberland Partners Ltd who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $916.67 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.44% or $0.81 during the last trading session, reaching $186.5. About 17.22M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since June 20, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
